_generated_by: the private place-and-route engine's report emitter, emit_plasticine_report (codegen_sva::plasticine_report) — never hand-edited; plasticine_report_lock regenerates it byte-equal
honesty: Every number is the paper-parameterized model's (ISCA'17 / SARA descriptors, Spatial's II definition, the PMU banking model, the checkerboard placer). Nothing here ran on a Plasticine simulator or on silicon; Tungsten rows land beside these under provenance `simulated_tungsten`.

model.control: every inter-stage channel carries a data-valid net forward and a space-available net backward (codegen_sva::choreography); its credit depth is the bandwidth-delay product ceil((forward + backward latency) / II) and the shipped depth is the deeper of that and Spatial's writer-to-reader N-buffer rule; control nets are budgeted on the SCALAR network against the PCU's control ports, separately from the vector network the data crosses. `plasticine_choreography_lock` proves the depth tight: at it the pipeline runs at exactly 1/II, and one credit less on any channel loses throughput
model.cycles: fill (Σ stage latency) + (iterations − 1) × II per unrolled instance; modeled cycles = max(compute, DRAM)
model.dram: cycles = bytes × clock_GHz / (GB/s); a GEMM tiling moves B column-panels once, A once per column panel, C once
model.ii: Spatial (Koeplinger et al., PLDI 2018, §4): stage II = max(resource II, recurrence II, memory II); pipeline II = the slowest stage; N-buffer depth = reader − writer + 1
model.pcu: ISCA'17 §3.1: a stage of depth D chains ceil(D / 6) PCUs, each 16 lanes wide; the reduction tree is log2(lanes)+1 stages
model.placement: row-balanced checkerboard placement; static routing by the private place-and-route engine over the mesh's routing-resource graph (one wire per channel of every DIRECTED link at Spade's vlink 2, unit vector ports, perimeter DRAM ports): the negotiated-congestion rung, the exact SAT rung on a stall, and the independent legality checker as the verdict; address-generator stages attach at the left/right perimeter switches (a port counts one hop)
model.pmu: ISCA'17 §3.2: 16 banks × 16 KB; strided banking at the access stride is conflict-free for 16 lanes; N-buffers partition the address space

not_modeled.name: data-dependent `while` loops (Collatz, the data_dependent_control corpus)
not_modeled.reason: a while loop's trip count is a runtime predicate; the metapipeline model takes counted loops (Spatial `Foreach`). These programs are proven ≡VM on the fabric's decision / loop mechanisms; a stream-controller (Spatial `Stream`/FSM) II model is the P5 follow-on

not_modeled.name: route128 top-8-of-128 MoE routing (whole function)
not_modeled.reason: three nested while loops over a heap-resident Seq — proven ≡VM on the fabric call-stack mechanism; the nested counter-chain controller model (Spatial `Foreach` nests with PMU-resident state) is P5. The argmax round it repeats eight times is modeled above

not_modeled.name: tiny transformer block / Qwen3-30B MoE routing at real scale
not_modeled.reason: nested loops with heap-resident tensors — same nested-controller gap as route128
